title: Moderation pipeline + queue + appeal + Apple 1.2 UGC compliance (AUTH #026)
summary: The publish moderation pipeline (SPEC §3.7, auto-clear + human-on-report): server-side GPS/EXIF re-strip → automated vision pass → auto-clear to public or route low-confidence to a human queue; under-review/cleared/rejected states with a one-line rejection reason + appeal; the human queue (gj-data, escalate to Owner) handles low-confidence flags, all user reports, and appeals, with no raw media to Bots beyond the thumbnail + package. Satisfies Apple guideline 1.2: content filter, report + timely response, block abusive users, published developer contact info. The UGC ToS/EULA copy is an in-house legal-team item. Security-sensitive → secondary review (AUTH #007).

acceptance_tests.test: Publish runs server-side GPS/EXIF re-strip → vision pass → auto-clear to public or route to the human queue on low confidence; the environment is creator-only until cleared; a rejection gives a one-line reason and an appeal.

One-tap reports (rate-limited) enter the queue and show 'Under review' to the reporter; the queue escalates to the Owner and exposes no raw media to Bots beyond the thumbnail + package (SECURITY_CHECKLIST §10.4).

Abusive users can be blocked and developer contact info is published (Apple 1.2 #3/#4); the vision pass covers the report reasons (private info visible, inappropriate, not a real place, broken) (SECURITY_CHECKLIST §10.5).
